name: – Dick Erixon – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section V – Court of Auditors
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the Court of Auditors spent its 2023 budget of about 175 million euros. It also asks the Court to do more: publish members' financial interests, cooperate fully with fraud investigators, join the EU Transparency Register, improve gender balance, and get full access to Recovery and Resilience Facility data. These are requests and opinions, not new laws.

- Parliament grants the Court's 2023 budget discharge; the Court must act on transparency and cooperation requests.
- Affects Court members and staff, and EU fraud bodies investigating them.
- Next: the Court reports back on these requests; Parliament reviews progress at the next discharge.
